Research Projects

Current Projects

AI-based CCTV System for Construction Site Monitoring

Duration: 2023-2024 | Role: Principal Investigator
Funding: National Research Foundation of Korea (NRF) - 210,000,000 WON

Developed a comprehensive AI-powered monitoring system that integrates computer vision and deep learning for real-time construction site safety monitoring. The system can detect various hazards, monitor worker behavior, and provide automated safety reports.

Technologies: Computer Vision, Deep Learning, YOLO, OpenCV, Python

Low-Light Image Enhancement Framework

Duration: 2024 | Role: Lead Researcher
Achievement: TOP5 in CVPR 2024 AICity Challenge

Developed an advanced image enhancement framework specifically designed for low-light conditions in fisheye lens datasets. The system significantly improves object detection accuracy in challenging lighting environments commonly found in surveillance and automotive applications.

Technologies: Image Processing, Deep Learning, PyTorch, Computer Vision

Vision-Language Model for Construction Safety

Duration: 2024 | Role: Lead Researcher
Achievement: TOP3 in CVPR 2024 VizWiz Grand Challenge

Implemented a state-of-the-art vision-language model that can understand complex visual questions about construction site safety. The system can identify hazards, answer safety-related queries, and generate comprehensive safety reports using natural language processing.

Technologies: Vision-Language Models, Transformers, PyTorch, NLP

Completed Projects

Forest Fire Response System

Duration: 2022 | Role: Lead Researcher
Publication: IEEE Access

Developed an intelligent wildfire detection and response system using deep learning algorithms. The system integrates CCTV imagery with weather data to provide early warning capabilities and automated response coordination for forest fire management.

Technologies: Deep Learning, Computer Vision, IoT Sensors, Weather Data Integration

VQA-RESCon: Visual Question Answering for Construction

Duration: 2023-2024 | Role: Lead Researcher
Publication: Automation in Construction

Created a visual question answering system specifically designed for construction safety analysis. The system can understand complex queries about construction site conditions and provide detailed safety assessments through natural language interaction.

Technologies: Visual Question Answering, Segmentation Models, PyTorch, Computer Vision

Damage Assessment Using UAV Images

Duration: 2020 | Role: Lead Researcher
Publication: Remote Sensing

Developed an automated damage assessment system using unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery and deep learning algorithms. The system can identify structural damage, assess severity levels, and generate comprehensive damage reports for disaster management applications.

Technologies: UAV Technology, Deep Learning, Image Analysis, Disaster Management
